messages:
Maya Chen: quick follow-up on the dequant fusion RFC - we should finalize the kernel ABI and a clear fallback plan before the A100 prototype.
Liam O'Connor: tl;dr: aim is to fuse dequant -> matmul -> softmax -> out-dequant to reduce memory traffic and KV cache churn. correctness first.
Omar Ruiz: big numeric worry: INT8/INT4 weight accumulations need FP32 accumulation, esp for per-head or per-row scales.
Evan Patel: perf spike summary: fused path ~2.9x on A100 vs fp16 baseline, ~1.7x on T4 for 2k causal LM. KV pack/unpack is expensive if we change layout.
Ciara Nguyen: cache concern: if fused kernels expect packed per-token QKV, current cache layout will break. Options: lightweight reorder on load or support alternate packed_cache behind a flag.
Maya Chen: proposed C-style ABI so kernels are explicit. example:
```
// simplified C ABI
void fused_q_attention(
  const void* q_quant, const void* k_quant, const void* v_quant,
  const void* wq_quant, const void* wk_quant, const void* wv_quant,
  const float* q_scale, const float* k_scale, const float* v_scale,
  const float* weight_scales, // per-head or per-tensor
  void* out_fp32, // caller-provided output
  const uint8_t flags // bitmask: per_head_scale | symmetric | packed_kv
);
```
Maya Chen: prefer flags to avoid hidden global state.
Omar Ruiz: how about mixed quant schemes (e.g., FP8 activations + INT4 weights)? kernel should accept a small descriptor per tensor: {dtype, scale_ptr, zp_ptr}.
Ciara Nguyen: +1. also decide whether kernel mutates long-lived cache. i prefer kernels not touch external cache; runtime will write packed cache when in packed_cache mode.
Evan Patel: microbench plan: harness that runs a single causal step with rotary + mask; capture latency, p99, and logits MSE vs fp16. targets: logits MSE < 1e-3; throughput >=1.8x on T4 and >=2.5x on A100.
Liam O'Connor: dispatch model: registry entries carry capability tags like ["fp8","int8","int4","per_head_scale","packed_kv","rotary","alibi"] and dispatcher picks the best match for the model profile.
Maya Chen: fallback behavior: if no compatible kernel -> runtime-dequant path (current code). add telemetry and per-model opt-in flag `enable_dequant_fusion`.
Omar Ruiz: numerical stability note: when fusing softmax + dequant, apply masking before softmax with large negative bias in FP32 to avoid fp8 saturation. add edge-case tests where all tokens masked.
Ciara Nguyen: packaging: for Dedicated/Private ship kernels as .so plus kernel-meta.json with capability list. runtime validates ABI on load. hosted can be more experimental.
Evan Patel: test matrix to add: per-head vs per-tensor scale, symmetric vs asymmetric quant, mixed dtype chains (fp8->int4), rotary/alibi, and both packed/unpacked cache flows.
Maya Chen: action items:
- Evan: expand perf harness and run full A100/T4 suite
- Liam: implement kernel registry + dispatch unit tests
- Omar: add numeric regression tests and accumulation checks
- Ciara: design packed_cache and adapter layer
I'll open a PR tomorrow with the ABI doc and a proto kernel.
Liam O'Connor: sg. i'll add dispatch tests and a staging canary that flips enable_dequant_fusion on a small model.
perf-bot: canary perf job queued: job/ri-fused-attn-canary-20260321
Ciara Nguyen: add migration note for saved KV caches: include a cache format version to avoid accidentally using packed kernels on old caches.
Omar Ruiz: rounding semantics: prefer round-to-nearest, ties-to-even to match PyTorch quant ops.
Maya Chen: agreed. thanks everyone, i'll post the PR and link perf numbers when available. :thumbsup:
